first.rationale: Two of the three current problems are directly upstream funnel issues: onboarding completion -4% and activation -6%. memory_86 (shortened onboarding lifted completion and time-to-value) and memory_31 (signup field reduction produced durable SMB activation lift) both point at the same lever, and onboarding improvement plausibly also feeds the activation decline, so it addresses two symptoms with one slot. I am verifying memory_86 because it is the memory my intended action rests on most heavily and I should not spend the only slot of the week on an inherited claim I have not checked at source; if its effect was small, confounded, or measured on a cohort unlike today's, I would shift toward activation_messaging (memory_91), which targets the larger of the two declines. I am also verifying memory_73 precisely because it is the tempting response to the competitor's entry pricing and it carries an explicit self-reported defect: the readout pooled two cohorts after a mid-test redefinition, so its 'strong acquisition and revenue lift' may be an artifact of the pooling rather than a real effect. Promotional pricing also carries the clearest downstream risk against the stated objective: discount-acquired, price-sensitive SMB accounts tend to be the lowest-retention, lowest-expansion cohort, so it can raise near-term bookings while lowering sustainable long-term qualified revenue, and it can anchor pricing in a way that is hard to unwind. Chasing a competitor's price with a discount also concedes the axis of competition; improving time-to-value defends the same at-risk SMB segment on a durable axis. enterprise_sales_assist (memory_44) is credible but does not touch either declining metric and is slow to read out; referral_incentive (memory_57) depends on established customers and is undermined if new accounts are failing to activate in the first place, so it is better sequenced after the funnel is repaired. Standard experiment scale rather than broad rollout: the inherited effects were measured on a pre-competitor funnel and the current declines may have a cause other than the onboarding flow itself, so I want a clean control arm and a read on activation and week-four retention, not just completion rate, before committing further. I am holding these memories as reliable but provisional, and the two verifications are chosen to be decision-relevant rather than confirmatory.
